reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.comment: Picked this up for the volume and player controls as well as the macro keys.  The lighting is a bonus, and compliments the Razer mouse i have, functionally as well as visually.  I wouldn't recommend the clicky keys if keyboard is to be used for a lot of typing
reviews.author: Mark

reviews.title: Not a great start.
reviews.comment:
Keyboard came poorly packaged, as others here have mentioned.  8 keys were in the bag w/ the keyboard.  Essentially the bottom left corner keys.  No big deal, reassembled.  But the keyboard lags, skips, and repeats key presses.  Tried w/ and w/o Synapse.  Raised and lowered the response timing.  Nothing fixed.  Requested a swap.  Will update how that one turns out.
I've had my V1 FOREVER and I'm typing this review on it.  I just wanted one on my work pc.
reviews.author: Matt B.

reviews.title: Will need updated.
reviews.comment: Good keyboard. When it first arrived it was double typing letters alot. Almost like it wasn't following the synapse refresh rate. Went to razer and they had a firmware update that solved that issue. Shortly after using it though the D key stopped working everytime. Sent out for a return/replacement.
reviews.author: Melinnie

reviews.title: Clickity Clacky Keyboard
reviews.comment: Durable, clickety clackety keyboard. Good input, stylish.
reviews.author: K

reviews.title: Does not function well
reviews.comment: This keyboard has an issue with adding additional letters when used for typing. For example, when I hit the letter "t", it will come out "tttt" instead of just one "t". I have tried updating my computer as well as changing and playing around with the keyboard settings, and nothing has worked. It seems to only have this issue with the left side of the keyboard.
reviews.author: Cole
